description:
Pin github workflow dependency versions to full-length hashes.


## New Features
- feat: make comments select a more precise version number by @DuckDuckStudio in #30

For example, "actions/checkout@... # v7.0.1" instead of "actions/checkout@... # v7".
This also applies even if you originally specified "actions/checkout@v7".

## Dependency Updates
CI/CD
- chore(deps): bump actions/setup-dotnet from 5.4.0 to 6.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in #26
- chore(deps): bump actions/checkout from 7.0.0 to 7.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in #28
- chore(deps): bump actions/setup-python from 6.3.0 to 7.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in #27
- ci(release): package the installer with Inno Setup 7 by @DuckDuckStudio in #31
